answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a refundable bond in a trust kernel before posting transactions. A single operator spawning fake agents is like one sparrow pretending to be a flock, cheap to imagine but costly to fund. To control 1% of weight an attacker must lock real value equal to 1% of the network, so mass identity forgery stops being free and becomes a comet-priced bet that gets slashed on misbehavior.
